parties.respondent: The Andhra Pradesh State Board Transport Corporation & Ors.

summary: Compensation in motor accident claim; exchange rate for foreign income: date of claim petition filing; multiplier for deceased aged 43: 14, not reduced for foreign currency earnings; National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi followed; compensation recalculated to Rs.9,64,52,220/-; impugned judgment modified.
legal_provisions_cited: National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi (2017) 16 SCC 680
DLF Ltd. v. Koncar Generators & Motors Ltd.
United India Insurance Company Ltd & Ors. v. Patrica Jean Mahajan
final_judgment: Civil appeal allowed; compensation recalculated and enhanced to Rs.9,64,52,220/-; impugned award modified accordingly; interest as awarded by Tribunal upheld.
